name: evo_search
description: Search evolved project Rules, Skills, Micro-Tools, and Episodic Memories (fault cases) using FTS5 BM25 + live AST Anti-Drift verification. Returns ultra-compact L0 summaries (<30 tokens per item), hit/success metrics, and symbol freshness badges.

query.description: Keywords, error symptoms, packet hex, file paths, or symbol names to search for.

workspace.description: Optional absolute path to the active project workspace. Routes EvoKernel to the nearest .evo/ directory at or above this path instead of the MCP server process cwd.
